question: Should task suggestions be enabled for Gateway-backed TUI sessions by adding an action-sink capability and TUI accept/dismiss UX, or should the tools remain Control UI-only for now?
rationale: The repair crosses model tool construction, Gateway event policy, and operator TUI UX; the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label and the current labels already mark it as needing product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the action-sink fix
options.body: Add the explicit sink capability, update tool exposure and Gateway-backed TUI accept/dismiss handling, and require focused source plus real TUI proof.

options.title: Keep Control UI-only
options.body: Gate task-suggestion tools to surfaces with the existing Control UI action flow and leave Gateway-backed TUI support for a later UX item.

options.title: Pause for broader task UX design
options.body: Keep this as maintainer-owned design work if the action model should cover more operator surfaces before implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the action-sink fix
recommendation.body: Add the explicit sink capability, update tool exposure and Gateway-backed TUI accept/dismiss handling, and require focused source plus real TUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the original task-suggestion feature path, is assigned on this issue, and has the strongest recent history on the relevant managed-worktree and Control UI session surfaces.
